name: Hybrid Local+Claude Agent (backlog #17 v2 -- real agent)

assignments.name: question
assignments.value: What is the capital of France?

nodes.name: Set Question
nodes.notes: Edit before running. Unlike v1's hardcoded IF router, the agent itself now decides whether to answer directly or invoke the Ask Claude tool -- try a simple question (should answer itself) and a time-sensitive one (should reach for the tool) to see both.

options.systemMessage: You are a helpful assistant. Answer directly from your own knowledge whenever you can do so confidently and accurately. Use the Ask Claude tool ONLY when the question needs very recent/current information, deep expert-level reasoning, or something you are genuinely not confident about. Do not use the tool for questions you can already answer well yourself.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: This is the actual agent: the connected Ollama chat model decides for itself, per-request, whether to answer directly or call the Ask Claude tool -- unlike v1's hardcoded IF node. If this node (or the two feeding it below) shows as an unrecognized/red node after import, n8n's LangChain node schemas moved between versions -- delete just that node and re-add it fresh from the node panel (AI -> Agent / Chat Model / Tool), then reconnect; the rest of the workflow is unaffected.

nodes.name: Ollama Chat Model
nodes.notes: qwen2.5:14b -- one of the 5 models on gpu-node-01 with tool-calling ('tools') capability, required for it to be able to decide to invoke Ask Claude. Needs an Ollama API credential assigned after import: baseUrl http://ollama.ollama.svc.cluster.local:11434, no auth. Remember Ollama needs replicas: 1 and ComfyUI replicas: 0 first (GPU toggle, see ../ollama-openwebui/README.md).

parameters.toolDescription: Ask a much more capable AI model (Claude) for help answering a question. Use this ONLY when you need very recent/current information, deep expert-level reasoning, or you are not confident in your own answer. Input should be the user's exact question as plain text.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 1024, messages: [{ role: "user", content: $fromAI('question', 'The exact question to ask Claude', 'string') }] }) }}

nodes.name: Ask Claude
nodes.notes: Needs an Anthropic API credential assigned after import (same as v1's escalation node -- console.anthropic.com, not checked into git). The agent decides on its own whether to call this, with what input, and how to use the response -- that's the actual agentic behavior v1 didn't have.

nodes.name: Final Result
nodes.notes: Inspect the `output` field -- the agent's final answer, after however many (zero or more) tool calls it decided to make on its own.
